section.sectionSummaryBrief: Introductory heading with the acronym "B'Siyata D'Shmaya" (with Divine assistance).
section.t: With the help of Heaven.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Explains that the future swallowing up of death is linked to the removal of the spirit of impurity, and that the sin of the Tree of Knowledge caused a mixture of good and evil, introducing death to prevent the eternal existence of evil.
section.t: “He will swallow up death forever, and the Lord G-d will wipe away tears from all faces.”
And the Rebbe Maharash explains in his discourse beginning with the words “Zeh” (this),
that this future swallowing up of death forever is because then “and the
spirit of impurity I will remove from the earth.”
And this will be understood by prefacing the reason explained in the verse
(later)
that through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, death came into the world,
meaning that death and the sin of the Tree of Knowledge are related to each other.
And the concept is,
that through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, a mixture of good and evil was made.
For the existence of evil existed also before the sin,
except that then evil was separate from good,
as is known,
that at the beginning of creation, the realm of the shells was below the worlds of holiness,
and through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, a mixture of good and evil was made
(in the entire world),
so that evil is mixed with good and good with evil,
to the point that there is no good without evil and no evil without good.
And this is what is written,
“And now, lest he send forth his hand and take also from the Tree of Life and eat, and live forever.”
For at first glance,
the creation of man
(from the outset)
was in a manner that he would live forever,
and the reason he was commanded not to eat from the Tree of Knowledge was so that he would not die
(as it is written,
“and from the Tree of Knowledge… you shall not eat from it, for on the day you eat from it you shall surely die”),
so what difference does it make if he eats from the Tree of Life and lives forever?
And the Alter Rebbe explains,
that since through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge evil became mixed into man,
therefore,
“and now”
(after the sin of the Tree of Knowledge)
there is a concern lest he send forth his hand… and live forever,
for if he were to live forever,
the evil mixed within him would also have eternal existence.
And based on this, it can be said,
that this—that through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge death came into the world—was so that evil would not have permanence,
as above.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Explains that death resulted naturally from the sin because evil is spiritual death, and the future removal of evil will cause the cessation of physical death as well.
section.t: And it can be said,
that the death in the world that came about through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge was caused by the sin itself.
And the concept is,
that the matter of life is specifically in holiness,
but evil and impurity
(the opposite of holiness)
are death,
therefore,
since through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge evil became mixed into man,
spiritual death,
from this there also devolved upon him physical death.
And this is also that which in the future death will be swallowed up forever,
for since then evil will be nullified,
spiritual death,
through this there will automatically also be the swallowing up of physical death.
